# Assessment Supplementary Documents

The following documents were copied from the ServiceFabric assessment fact outputs. The deployment subtree does not contain application source, so API contracts, data entities, and business workflows are limited to what manifests expose.

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) — Service Fabric container deployment topology and declared component relationships.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) — Declared build/package dependencies and compatibility observations.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) — Declared service listener ports and communication visible from deployment manifests.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) — Data entity analysis was unavailable because no data-access source was found.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) — Service Fabric profiles, environment properties, startup settings, and masked secret references.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) — Business workflow analysis was unavailable because application business logic is outside this subtree.
